1001.synopsis:
Kyoukai Senjou no Horizon chronicles the story of a futuristic civilization returned to Earth after constant warfare hindered them from traveling beyond the post-Apocalyptic Earth. At this stage, a small archipelago called the Divine States were the only hospitable land on Earth. In order to regain the space-faring technology they had lost after many years of war, they decided to recreate history with a book called the Testament as a guide.
It is the year 1648 in the Testament Era. Toori Aoi, Chancellor and Student Council President of the only academy on the airborne city-ship Musashi, faces the ten-year anniversary of the death of his childhood friend Horizon Ariadust in an accident. As he prepares to celebrate the occasion by proposing to P-01s (an automaton who looks exactly like Horizon) he discovers that his suspicion about P-01s’ appearance actually has a basis in truth; P-01s is in fact Horizon Ariadust, reborn into a robotic body. In addition to this, Horizon’s emotions had been stripped away and are now stored in eight powerful weapons called the Mortal Sin Armaments; which are now in the possession of key people in various established countries in the Divine States.
To retrieve the emotions of Horizon Ariadust, Toori Aoi along with his friends and allies begins a crusade against different obstacles as key events in history are recreated in a futuristic manner.

“The good news.”
“The good news is, we’ve transmigrated! This is a vast interstellar era, and we are now superhuman warriors with two hearts and three lungs, holding a high status. Looks like we even got a very WAAAGH-worthy cheat as a bonus.”
“That’s awesome! Isn’t this just the kind of treatment a protagonist in an isekai power fantasy gets? I can’t wait to enjoy my new life in another world. Oh, by the way, can I bring my parents over too? Right, so… what’s the bad news?”
“The bad news is… in our world, this place is called Warhammer 40K.”
“…Huh?”  
They took a deep breath, carefully contemplating and exploring this unfamiliar world. They went with the flow—after all, reality had left them no other choice.  
They wept like a snot-nosed goblin who just had its toes stepped on, yet they still mustered the courage to move forward.  
In the dark forty-first millennium, humanity once again welcomed an opportunity for revival.  
But this time—will humanity seize it?  
—Let war begin!  
From the skies of Terra to the edge of the galaxy.  
Let the stars burn.  
Let the heavens go silent.  
Let us witness once more—the liberation of the galaxy.  
The liberation of humanity.

107753.synopsis:
To Jiwon, Kang Haesung is… Dragon tattoo. Bad impressions. Large man. A scary sunbae.
She never thought she’d have anything to do with him, but they end up crossing paths due to an unexpected situation…
Jiwon tries to give him her sincere gratitude and move on, but…
“Let’s date.”
…she heard something completely unexpected.
“Let’s try seeing each other.”
Before she could grow flustered and ask him what in the world he’s talking about, Haesung rushes in.
“…Sunbae, I like younger men.”
“Aah, I see.”
“……”
“Noona.”
Jiwon, who tries to return to her senses, and Haesung, the man who won’t let her.
What will their relationship look like?

109289.synopsis:
Yeo Eungyeom has been secretly harboring a long-standing crush on his high school classmate, Seo Kijoon. After a chance encounter leads them to become friends with benefits, Eungyeom receives a sudden and unexpected proposition one day:
“Do you want to sleep with my brother?”
Constantly frustrated by the knowledge that Kijoon has numerous other partners, Eungyeom accepts the offer out of spite. Feeling somewhat miserable, he goes to the designated meeting place, only to be met with an all too familiar face.
“You said he was your brother. Were you twins?”
“He is my brother. My twin brother.”
But the surprise is short-lived. Seo Gihyun, whom Eungyeom thought he’d only had a one-time encounter with, perceives Eungyeom’s feelings for Kijoon and proposes a secretive and seductive deal.
He offers to “help the two of you get together, in exchange for becoming my SM partner for a short period.”
Eungyeom initially refuses the absurd offer, but due to Kijoon’s provocations, he accepts in a fit of anger, and the unstable relationship between the three continues.
However, Eungyeom begins to sense something more than just interest in the twins’ gazes…

109801.synopsis:
“Why should I marry you?”
“I told you already, didn’t I? I need someone as insensitive as you.”
“But why?”
“You’ll find out slowly later. Anyway, we need to get married within a month, so prepare yourself.”
“Are you dying in a month?”
While Junghyun was talking nonsense about whether the other man didn’t want to become a bachelor ghost, he noticed Cha Jaehyuk glancing at his phone screen.
After checking what appeared to be an incoming message, Cha Jaehyuk looked back at him and beckoned with his finger, as if telling him to look.
“What?”
When Junghyun looked at him with a face that said “speak if you have something to say,” Cha Jaehyuk narrowed his eyes and smiled brightly.
With a gaze so hot it could melt someone, so enchantingly beautiful.
Unlike moments before, he was now staring at Junghyun with such an intense, loving gaze that it sent chills down Junghyun’s spine.
Feeling like something had gone terribly wrong, Junghyun tried to move away, but Cha Jaehyuk was faster.
Suddenly closing the distance between them, he leaned toward Junghyun’s shoulder and whispered directly into his ear.
“You should think carefully about what’s advantageous for you. Whether you want it or not, you’re destined to go through with this marriage.”
The strong scent that enveloped him made Junghyun’s entire body shiver.
He was definitely an S-ranker.
Junghyun had sensed it somewhat since their first meeting in the elevator, but it became obvious when they got closer.
Even though Cha Jaehyuk was likely suppressing it as much as possible, it was still difficult to handle.
His skin hurt. It felt like a mild electric shock.
The sensation was uncomfortable.
“First, I’d appreciate it if you’d keep your distance.”
“Why?”
“I’m someone who needs a wide personal space. This distance is extremely uncomfortable for me.”
“Your answer first?”
“If it’s about marriage, then no.”
“Didn’t I tell you that you don’t have a choice?”
“No, I do have a choice. I can simply not show up at the wedding.”
When Junghyun boasted that he wouldn’t meekly walk into a wedding ceremony just because his family forced him to marry—that he could even give the middle finger to the officiant and run away—Cha Jaehyuk smiled languidly.
Chillingly.
“You’ve got spirit too. I’m liking you more and more.”

112361.synopsis:
Xie Jiulou had been Yama for three hundred years. The first time he saw Ti Deng in the Underworld, he thought to himself, “This person is beautiful, I want to keep him.” So he kept Ti Deng detained for three hundred years.
During those three hundred years, he did everything he should and shouldn’t have done to Ti Deng; there wasn’t a single part of the other’s body he hadn’t touched. Except for two things Xie Jiulou absolutely dared not touch. One was a jade thumb ring, the other a pair of gold chopsticks.
Both items were gifts to Ti Deng from that person. Who that person was, Xie Jiulou never asked. But every time Ti Deng lingered his gaze upon them, Xie Jiulou would find ways to retaliate.
He retaliated in his sleeping palace, behind his hanging curtains, in the pepper-scented room he had built for Ti Deng. He used methods Ti Deng didn’t want, in all the places Ti Deng didn’t want.
Later, one time, Xie Jiulou couldn’t resist and secretly followed Ti Deng out, watching him chat idly with someone on the street.
That person said, “Your jade thumb ring is truly beautiful.”
Ti Deng smiled. “A gift from an old friend.”
When Ti Deng smiled, Xie Jiulou seethed with jealousy. Ti Deng had never smiled at him like that.
That person asked again, “What old friend?”
Ti Deng smiled again. “Someone you don’t know.”
Xie Jiulou’s teeth itched even more. Ti Deng smiled so beautifully, as if that old friend were some privately treasured secret, one he was utterly unwilling to let any outsider know even a little about.
Then he heard Ti Deng say, “Called Xie Jiulou. Been dead for many years.”

112617.synopsis:
It was a world where everything was new to her.
Rosanna, a half-blood born of demon and human, suddenly finds herself in the human realm.
There, her life is saved by a man.
Raphael Caissen. The man most blessed by God.
If he ever discovered her true identity, he would never let her live.
Rosanna tried to escape from him.
“Ah.”
In that moment, an uncontrollable heat surged through her body.
Rosanna realized there was no place left for her to run.
It was a sign of pheromone awakening.

115689.synopsis:
[Tomb Raiding + Mystery + Antique Appraisal] 
I am a poor boy from a small northeastern mountain village. At the dawn of the 21st century, in pursuit of a better life, I joined a northern tomb raiding group.
From south to north, I’ve seen the myriad faces of society, mingling with people from all walks of life, the good, the bad, and the strange.
Over the years, I’ve gone from a reckless youth to a weathered middle-aged man—my drinking capacity has improved, but time has left its marks.
I’ve encountered countless extraordinary people and bizarre events during this journey. If you’re interested, grab a small stool and come listen to the tales of a tomb raider’s life and the fascinating stories of the underworld.
associated_names: 来自一位盗墓者的自传最新章节列表

118505.synopsis:
Qing Li, an ordinary university student from the Flower Nation, transmigrated into the body of a grand elder in the cultivation world. After lying low for ten years, she sacrificed herself to save that realm.
But Heaven gave her a second chance. By fate, she made a deal with an interstellar woman named Jiang Qingli:
—She would take over Jiang Qingli’s body in exchange for keeping her two children safe and raising them well.
Qing Li thought this meant a peaceful retirement raising kids in the interstellar world. But upon arrival, she found out her new life was broke—so broke she couldn’t even afford nutrient packs.
The house left behind by the original body’s parents had been seized by her uncle’s family. Her newborn daughter had been swapped at birth.
And even after all that, the uncle still wouldn’t back off—he planned to trade her to an ability-user for resources.
Qing Li wanted to rise again, but the body was in shambles. So she chose to pull the rug out and change planets.
Sold the house.
As for where that uncle would live now? Not her problem.
She grabbed the fake daughter and forced her cousin to return custody of the real one.
Then, with money and children in hand, she signed up to be an explorer on a desolate star.
associated_names: 修真老祖在星际带崽，活着就好

120553.synopsis:
Luo You had once been a female executive in an evil organization whose primary business was hunting magical girls.
She specialized in capturing and disciplining them—
Unlocking and collecting over ten thousand defeat CGs of magical girls.
And yet, one day, she suddenly chose to betray the organization.
She adopted a daughter.
Withdrew from the public eye.
But fate is never so kind.
Years later, he became her once more.
Since it was all back to square one anyway—
Might as well return to the old business!
“This time… which one should I choose?”
associated_names: A Witch who Hunts Magical Girls would never get Reverse-Killed!
狩猎魔法少女的魔女才不会被反杀

121065.synopsis:
One day, Seo Jehyun finds himself transmigrated as a villain in a modern fantasy novel [I’m the Only Overpowered S-Rank Hunter]  written by his old high-school friend.
But… can this even be called possession? After all, the hidden villain that appears in the novel is already named Seo Jehyun.
So, in order not to break the coherence of being the villain and to uncover the cause of everything that’s happened, Seo Jehyun resolves to follow the original plot faithfully.
He decides: I’ll do my best to become The Apocalypse.
associated_names: Turns Out, I’m Perfectly Suited to Be the Villain
헌터물 흑막에 빙의했는데 적성에 너무 잘 맞음

121321.synopsis:
My name is Aixinjueluo Yongcong. My father is Qianlong, and my mother is Empress Fucha.  
I was born with a silver spoon in my mouth… until I died at the age of two.  
—That was my past life, according to a fortune-teller.  
I scoffed. Yeah, right!  
And then I transmigrated into the infant Yongcong.  
Historical records state: In the third year of Qianlong’s reign, the eldest son Yonglian passed away and was posthumously honored as Crown Prince Duanhui. In the twelfth year, the second son Yongcong died and was posthumously honored as Prince Daomin. In the thirteenth year, Empress Fucha passed away and was posthumously honored as Empress Xiaoxian.  
My brother lived to nine, my mother to thirty-six, and I only made it to two…  
No, forget two! In Qing Dynasty dramas, I wouldn’t survive past three episodes.  
Soon, I realized I was overthinking it.  
My brother is a time traveler, my mother is a reborn soul, Huang Ama would pluck stars for me, and Imperial Grandmother would fetch the moon if I asked.  
Me: ??  
This isn’t what the history books said.  
This is how Yongcong describes his Qing Dynasty time-travel life:  
At first, I feared for my life. Later, I resisted being smothered with affection…

121577.synopsis:
Ennid, a genius alchemist.
Under the king’s order, he researches a potion to see ‘one’s future marriage partner’.
Meanwhile, Ennid saves a child who is being sold as a s*ave and lets him into his house. This is because he saw that child as his marriage partner while testing the potion…
‘There’s no way I’m going to marry an eight-year-old… The potion must have been made incorrectly.’
Ennid, who thought so, observes the child next to him and tries to get a clue to complete the potion.
On the other hand, the child’s identity was an adult male whose body was young due to a curse, a cruel man called the Bloodthirsty Grand Duke…

125673.synopsis:
When the King of Love Songs, Gu Panqiu, opened his eyes, he came to realize that he had actually transmigrated into the pages of a melodramatic BL novel, The King of Showbiz, where he became a love-crazed cannon fodder with the same name.
In the book, Gu Panqiu was utterly smitten with his white moonlight*, Lu Yao, to the point of losing himself in the depths of his obsession. But Lu Yao’s heart belonged to CEO Fu Yue, the domineering figure of the entertainment industry. In the end, his unrequited love shattered him, leaving him to wither away in despair.
But… what the book did not mention was that the original host was also a male mother with a three-year-old son.
A week later.
Trending Forum Thread: Gu Panqiu, a father?! He’s brought his son onto a dating reality show! Now, he’s so irresistible that he’s deemed the epitome of pure desire!
In order to make ends meet, Gu Panqiu brought his three-and-a-half-year-old son, Jiujiu, onto a same-s*x dating reality show, where he decided to just go with the flow and be a salted fish**.
On his first day on set, Gu Panqiu prepared a whole fish feast in the kitchen, gladly taking on the role of chef for the guests, who were more absorbed in love than in the food.
Top-Tier Producer: What a clever little trick! Is he trying to tempt me with a feast fit for royalty? And that waist cinched by the apron… It’s so slender I can’t help but imagine how it would feel in my grasp.
Gu Panqiu: ?
While the other guests laughed and clinked glasses on Gu Panqiu’s second day on set, he remained focused on his career. Amid the revelry, he quietly took his place on stage and sang a love song, his heart fully immersed in the music.
Innocent Campus Heartthrob: His voice is sooo sexy! His eyes are so beautiful! Oh! He just looked at me… I’m positive he’s sending me a signal!
Gu Panqiu: ??
On the third day on set, Gu Panqiu played games with his little one, who eagerly asked to be held. Lifting the child into his arms, his gaze drifted toward the window. The melancholic expression on his face resembled an oil painting bathed in the glow of the setting sun.
Elite Lawyer: I’d just stepped into the living room when Qiuqiu gazed out the window. His eyes are gentle yet tinged with a hint of loneliness… Is he worried I wouldn’t like him?
Gu Panqiu: ???
To fend off the enigmatic admirers, Gu Panqiu gazed into the camera, his eyes filled with grief. With a tremor in his voice, he confessed, “I’m still struggling to move past the shadows of a breakup because I still love the father of my child. I hope everyone can give me a little more time…” He finished with a soft, almost pitiful whimper.
But still… who on earth was the child’s other father?
One day, his “love rival,” Fu Yue, came knocking.
Clad in a tailored suit, Fu Yue pulled out a paternity test report. “There are two things I need to say,” he stated firmly. “First, Jiujiu is my son, and I will take responsibility.”
Furrowing his brow, Fu Yue favored him with a hard stare. “Second,” he began, “I heard you love me?”
Gu Panqiu gaped, utterly floored. Wait, aren’t they supposed to be… love rivals?
Bonus Scene:
Calm and reserved, Fu Yue always kept his shirt buttoned all the way to the top.
The production crew paired Gu Panqiu and Fu Yue for an ABO roleplay. With that, Fu Yue delivered his lines with icy indifference, “You’ve given me two children already, and yet you still don’t believe I love you?”
The very next second, Gu Panqiu tripped over the air. Cloaked in the crisp scent of cedar, he tumbled into Fu Yue’s embrace, his pointed chin resting lightly on his shoulder.
Fu Yue’s breath caught in his throat. With a frown, he stared the other down. “What exactly do you think you’re doing?”
“You’re so mean, CEO Fu…” Gu Panqiu’s eyes shimmered with unshed tears as he curled into Fu Yue’s arms. “I’ll only believe that you love me if you hug me.”
Note:
1. Naturally seductive, cute-acting, sweet-voiced Heavenly King × Reserved, mensao, aloof CEO
From rivals to lovers. Bottom has a bit of a heartthrob quality, but only has eyes for Top. Loyal to a fault, Top dotes on him endlessly. At their core, they’re both deeply in love with each other.
2. The story is set in a FICTIONAL world where some men can conceive and bear children. Both Bottom and Top are pure and chaste!
3. A heartwarming, healing fairytale romance with a dash of melodrama and a whole lot of sweetness. And yes, Bottom is the one who gave birth to his son.
* – 白月光 (bái yuè guāng): The term literally means “white moonlight” and refers to someone who holds a special place in one’s heart—often a first love or an idealized person from the past. The term usually carries a sense of longing, regret, or emotional distance.
** – 咸鱼 (xián yú): The term originally comes from Cantonese slang for a corpse. Now, it is also a Chinese internet slang term that is used to describe someone who is lazy, unmotivated, and has no intention of doing anything.

126441.synopsis:
Life was a punishment to him.
He stood on death every day. His worn-out arms and death itself had become a habit to him.
Yoongeon, as always, tried to push Seohwi away. For the sake of Seohwi’s peaceful life, he was willing to suppress himself and disappear.
“Why? Because I can’t step inside that damned line? So I’m not worthy of you?”
Yoongeon knew he had to distance himself from him.
But why, this time, wouldn’t Seohwi be pushed away?

129001.synopsis:
To save you, I have to sleep with you.
Muyeong decides to pursue a relationship with Uiseong, someone from his past. Even if Uiseong doesn’t remember him, if that’s the way to save him.
“Well, today’s not quite right. Shall we start tomorrow?” 
“…What are you talking about?” 
“Sex. Didn’t you come here after hearing the full explanation?” 
“I… Yes, that’s right. I heard everything.”
Yes. There’s no other reason for coming here. Because it’s necessary. Because I want to breathe in a place where I’m needed.
It felt like something massive was collapsing inside his chest.
Those moments were the first, like a bolt of lightning. Uiseong forgot it all. Once again.
Uiseong, who lost his memories due to the aftereffects of treatment, and Muyeong, who became a housekeeper.
It was a choice made just to stay by his side, but something about Uiseong feels off.
“Next time, I’ll leave a bit earlier to avoid running into you.” 
“Why? I’m not uncomfortable.”
The doctor clearly said it would be problematic if Uiseong remembered Muyeong.
He thought it was enough for him to love Uiseong, hoping only for his happiness, but now confusion clouds all those feelings.

142825.synopsis:
“The Yeonjun you knew is gone now.”
Three years ago, Heecheong threw himself into the triad to find Yeonjun, who had suddenly disappeared. As the chairman’s mistress and a commodity desired by countless people, he unexpectedly reunites with Yeonjun — but Yeonjun only humiliates him and drives him into a corner.
“Between family, things like this…!”
“If we become husband and wife, we can do things like this, right?”
A love-hate relationship that only grows deeper. Will Heecheong and Yeonjun ever be able to regain the tenderness of their past?

170729.synopsis:
Pei Hening thinks her boyfriend has gone insane.
In the middle of the night, he drags her out of bed to play a survival game, claiming that in six hours, they will be pulled into that very game—
Well, if it comes, they’ll deal with it. Even if the game descends upon reality, they still have to survive.
But can someone explain to her… why her starting vehicle is a pair of roller skates?!
—
In the second year after Highway Survival begins, Chu Xuan’ge locates his girlfriend’s position and uses a Region Transfer Card to reunite with her. He believes nothing will ever separate them again—
But during a major regional instance, she is killed.
He embarks on a path of vengeance.
By the fifth year of Highway Survival, Chu Xuan’ge slaughters all his enemies and, in despair, takes his own life.
When he opens his eyes again—
He has been reborn to a time before the game’s closed beta even began.
associated_names: 公路求生，我的恋爱脑男友重生了
